Name: Start In Ginger Island
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3][size=3]You wake up stranded in the island, only with a tent and some starter items. This mod has difficulty settings. [b][size=3][size=3]
Multiplayer compatible[/size][/size][/b]

[b][u]Features[/u][/b]:
[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Configurable difficulty[/size]
[*][size=3]Pirate "Clint" (tool upgrade / geodes)[/size]
[*][size=3]Pirates' weapon seller / item recovery[/size]
[*][size=3]4 new weapons[/size]
[*][size=3]Repair willy's boat to return to society[/size]
[/list][size=3]
As you progress through the island, the mod changes. Pros of starting in the island:[list]
[*]Learn dwarvish faster!
[*]Immediate tool upgrades. No need to wait 3 days!
[*]All the benefits of Ginger Island, early game
[*]Ostrich Coop on the island (buildable)
[*]Peace and quiet
[/list][/size]
[size=3][size=3]For hints on how to progress, see the mod articles. [/size][/size][b]

[/b][size=3][b][u]Caveats[/u][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If you unlock the boat and you still can't get back to town, try sleeping and restarting the game. (As of now, it's unknown why this happens)[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]If you like what i do, [url=https://ko-fi.com/mistyspring][b]consider buying me a coffee [/b][b]♥.[/b][/url][/size]
